description: This file defines classes related to XML-RPC handling, including data value representations, message parsing, server, client, request, error, and date classes. It implements a server for XML-RPC communication, including handling method calls, parsing XML messages, and managing callbacks.

classes.name: IXR_Value
classes.description: Represents an XML-RPC value, capable of calculating its type and generating XML representation.

classes.name: IXR_Message
classes.description: Handles parsing and representing an XML-RPC message, including method call or response.

classes.name: IXR_Server
classes.description: Implements an XML-RPC server, handling incoming requests, parsing messages, and invoking registered callbacks.

classes.name: IXR_Request
classes.description: Creates and manages an XML-RPC request message, including generating its XML.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: XML-RPC client for sending requests to an XML-RPC server and receiving responses.

classes.name: IXR_Error
classes.description: Represents an error returned by an XML-RPC server, capable of generating XML fault responses.

classes.name: IXR_Date
classes.description: Handles XML-RPC dateTime.iso8601 values, parsing, and generating ISO8601 formatted dates.

classes.name: IXR_Base64
classes.description: Represents base64-encoded binary data in XML-RPC messages.

classes.name: IXR_IntrospectionServer
classes.description: Extends IXR_Server to support introspection methods like system.listMethods, system.getCapabilities, etc.

classes.name: IXR_ClientMulticall
classes.description: Client class for performing multicall requests in XML-RPC.

methods.name: calculateType
methods.description: Determines the XML-RPC type of the data held within IXR_Value.

methods.name: getXml
methods.description: Returns the XML representation of the IXR_Value instance based on its type.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the XML message and populates the class properties accordingly.

methods.name: tag_open
methods.description: Handles XML start tags during parsing.

methods.name: cdata
methods.description: Handles character data within XML elements during parsing.

methods.name: tag_close
methods.description: Handles XML end tags during parsing and assigns values accordingly.

methods.name: serve
methods.description: Starts the XML-RPC server to handle incoming requests and send responses.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Executes a registered method or callback with given parameters.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Outputs an error response, either as a fault or message.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Sends the XML response back to the requester.

methods.name: hasMethod
methods.description: Checks if a method is registered in the server callbacks.

methods.name: setCapabilities
methods.description: Initializes server capabilities information.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Returns server capabilities information.

methods.name: setCallbacks
methods.description: Registers system methods for the server.

methods.name: listMethods
methods.description: Returns a list of available server methods.

methods.name: multiCall
methods.description: Handles multicall requests, executing multiple methods in one request.

methods.name: IXR_Request
methods.description: Creates an XML-RPC method call message with specified method name and parameters.

methods.name: getLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the XML request message.

methods.name: getXml
methods.description: Returns the XML of the request message.

methods.name: IXR_Client
methods.description: Client for making XML-RPC requests to a server, handling connection, request sending, and response parsing.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Sends an XML-RPC request and processes the response.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Retrieves the response parameter from the message.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if the last operation resulted in an error.

methods.name: getErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the last error code.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns the last error message.

methods.name: IXR_Error
methods.description: Represents an XML-RPC fault/error message with code and description.

methods.name: IXR_Date
methods.description: Represents dateTime values in XML-RPC, providing parsing and formatting methods.

methods.name: getIso
methods.description: Returns ISO8601 string of the date.

methods.name: getXml
methods.description: Returns the XML representation of the date.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns UNIX timestamp for the date.

methods.name: IXR_Base64
methods.description: Base64 data handler for XML-RPC.

methods.name: getXml
methods.description: Returns the base64 encoded XML element.

methods.name: IXR_IntrospectionServer
methods.description: Provides introspection methods like listing methods and getting signatures.

methods.name: addCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback method with signature and help string.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Overrides call method to include signature and argument validation.

methods.name: methodSignature
methods.description: Returns the signature of a server method.

methods.name: methodHelp
methods.description: Returns help string for a server method.

methods.name: IXR_ClientMulticall
methods.description: Supports multiple method calls in one request.

methods.name: addCall
methods.description: Adds a method call to the multicall queue.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes the multicall request.
